description: Source code for the OX_ParserBase class, which extends XML_Parser to parse XML plugin installation files in the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OX_ParserBase
classes.description: A class that extends XML_Parser to handle parsing of plugin install XML files, managing plugin metadata, files, dependencies, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with default encoding and mode.

methods.name: _initArray
methods.description: Initializes internal arrays for plugin data.

methods.name: _assignArray
methods.description: Assigns parsed data to structured plugin arrays.

methods.name: startHandler
methods.description: Handles the start of XML elements, initializing data structures based on element type.

methods.name: endHandler
methods.description: Handles the end of XML elements, finalizing data collection.

methods.name: cdataHandler
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements, updating plugin data accordingly.

methods.name: raiseInstanceError
methods.description: Generates and raises detailed parsing errors.
